headline: Wisconsin Act 76 ratifies Respiratory Care Interstate Compact, says Rep Jessie Rodriguez
dek: Wisconsin State Representative Jessie Rodriguez said the act she authored lets respiratory therapists licensed in good standing in their home state practise in Wisconsin.
body:
Wisconsin State Representative Jessie Rodriguez said she authored 2026 Wisconsin Act 76, which ratifies the Respiratory Care Interstate Compact in the state. She made the statement in a post on X on 18 November 2026.

According to Rodriguez, the act creates a pathway for respiratory therapists who hold a licence in good standing in their home state to practise in Wisconsin.

Rodriguez wrote that she had promoted lung health with the legislation "this session". She noted that November is National COPD Awareness Month and also Lung Cancer Awareness Month. Her X profile says she represents Assembly District 21 and serves Oak Creek, Milwaukee and Greenfield.
key_quote: creating a pathway for respiratory therapists who hold a license in good standing in their home state to practice in Wisconsin
